candidates.title: Discharge Permits in Significant Noncompliance
candidates.description: Permit holders found to be in significant noncompliance (SNC) as required by §9-328.1 of the Environment Article. This list reflects the status in EPA's ICIS database as of June 30, 2025. This reflects the most current quarter available through Environmental Compliance History Online (ECHO).
